posts.text:
This was obvious to me during Covid. Why can i order a baseball glove from Amazon that had thousands working indoors but my local sporting goods store had to close cuz of lockdown safety? 

That never made sense. 

It was an obvious plan to screw small businesses & transfer wealth to huge corporations. 

Still almost nobody talks about it. “Covid is over” they say as if it’s unreasonable to want the biggest crime in history investigated & prosecuted.
